title: Astragaloside IV Blunts Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition and G2/M Arrest to Alleviate Renal Fibrosis via Regulating ALDH2-Mediated Autophagy.
authors: Li, Dong; Liu, Yuzhe; Zhan, Quancao; Zeng, Yan; Peng, Ze; He, Qifeng; Tan, Qi; Cao, Wenfu; Wang, Shang; Wang, Jianwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪甲苷通过ALDH2介导的自噬缓解肾纤维化，仅涉及药物-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Previous studies show that astragaloside IV (ASIV) has anti-renal fibrosis effects. However, its mechanism remains elusive. In this study, we investigated the anti-fibrosis mechanisms of ASIV on chronic kidney disease (CKD) in vivo and in vitro. A CKD model was induced in rats with adenine (200 mg/kg/d, i.g.), and an in vitro renal fibrosis model was induced in human kidney-2 (HK-2) cells treated with TGF-beta1. We revealed that ASIV significantly alleviated renal fibrosis by suppressing the expressions of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-related proteins, including fibronectin, vimentin, and alpha-smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA), and G2/M arrest-related proteins, including phosphorylated p53 (p-p53), p21, phosphorylated histone H3 (p-H3), and Ki67 in both of the in vivo and in vitro models. Transcriptomic analysis and subsequent validation showed that ASIV rescued ALDH2 expression and inhibited AKT/mTOR-mediated autophagy. Furthermore, in ALDH2-knockdown HK-2 cells, ASIV failed to inhibit AKT/mTOR-mediated autophagy and could not blunt EMT and G2/M arrest. In addition, we further demonstrated that rapamycin, an autophagy inducer, reversed the treatment of ASIV by promoting autophagy in TGF-beta1-treated HK-2 cells. A dual-luciferase report assay indicated that ASIV enhanced the transcriptional activity of the ALDH2 promoter. In addition, a further molecular docking analysis showed the potential interaction of ALDH2 and ASIV. Collectively, our data indicate that ALDH2-mediated autophagy may be a novel target in treating renal fibrosis in CKD models, and ASIV may be an effective targeted drug for ALDH2, which illuminate a new insight into the treatment of renal fibrosis and provide new evidence of pharmacology to elucidate the anti-fibrosis mechanism of ASIV in treating renal fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 前期研究表明，黄芪甲苷IV (ASIV) 具有抗肾纤维化作用，但其机制尚不明确。本研究在体内和体外探讨了ASIV对慢性肾脏病 (CKD) 的抗纤维化机制。通过腺嘌呤 (200 mg/kg/d, i.g.) 诱导大鼠CKD模型，并在人肾小管上皮细胞 (HK-2) 中经TGF-β1处理建立体外肾纤维化模型。我们发现，ASIV在体内和体外模型中均显著减轻肾纤维化，通过抑制上皮-间质转化 (EMT) 相关蛋白（包括纤连蛋白、波形蛋白和α-平滑肌肌动蛋白 (α-SMA)）以及G2/M期阻滞相关蛋白（包括磷酸化p53 (p-p53)、p21、磷酸化组蛋白H3 (p-H3) 和Ki67）的表达。转录组分析及后续验证显示，ASIV恢复了ALDH2表达，并抑制了AKT/mTOR介导的自噬。此外，在ALDH2敲低的HK-2细胞中，ASIV未能抑制AKT/mTOR介导的自噬，也无法减轻EMT和G2/M期阻滞。进一步研究表明，自噬诱导剂雷帕霉素通过促进TGF-β1处理的HK-2细胞中的自噬，逆转了ASIV的治疗效果。双荧光素酶报告实验显示，ASIV增强了ALDH2启动子的转录活性。此外，分子对接分析进一步揭示了ALDH2与ASIV之间的潜在相互作用。综上所述，我们的数据表明，ALDH2介导的自噬可能是治疗CKD模型中肾纤维化的新靶点，而ASIV可能是一种有效的ALDH2靶向药物，这为肾纤维化的治疗提供了新见解，并为阐明ASIV在治疗肾纤维化中的抗纤维化机制提供了新的药理学证据。
